messages:
Olivia: Quick sync — planning a small canary to enable int4 precision on sherpa-13b (inference profile: session-embed). Proposal: flag `quant_toggle:sherpa13b_int4` -> ON for 1% traffic, 4h window, start 15:00 PT. Any blockers? :eyes:
Samir: Sounds reasonable. Metrics we care about: p95 latency, token cost, error-rate (5xx), and embed-similarity drift vs baseline. Can we set automatic rollback thresholds?
Mira: Recommended rollback:
- p95 latency increase > 20ms over baseline
- 5xx rate > 0.5% absolute
- similarity drift (cosine) > 0.6 percentile drop on eval set
If any trigger hit, auto rollback and page SRE.
Kevin: Can you share the CLI snippet to run? I'll queue it.
Olivia: Yep — using redwoodctl feature toggle:
```
redwoodctl feature set quant_toggle:sherpa13b_int4 --env prod --rollout 0.01 --duration 4h --auto-rollback 'p95>20ms || 5xx>0.5% || drift>0.6%'
```
Also adding canary tags: `audience=small-dev`, `exclude_customer_ids=acct_42,acct_314`
Samir: Make sure traffic split is by user-id hashing so sessions remain consistent. For safety cohort exclude enterprise customers and internal beta.
Mira: Add monitoring hooks:
- PromQL p95: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{model=\"sherpa-13b\"}[5m])) by (le))`
- 5xx: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{code=~\"5..\", model=\"sherpa-13b\"}[5m]))`
I'll add alert rule to fire if thresholds breach for 2 consecutive 5m windows.
Olivia: Scheduling now for 2026-03-17T15:00PT — will post canary-id when scheduled.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: id=cny-20260317-01, rollout=1%, start=2026-03-17T22:00:00Z
Samir: Thumbs up. I'll watch latency dashboards and run sample eval set qps tests.
Mira: Also add a small QA traffic generator hitting edge cases (empty prompt, long prompt, tool-calling). I'll drop a short script in #eng-ml later.
Kevin: Pinging reviews: PR #4523 has the precision profile and unit tests. @Olivia can you patch the feature flag name there?
Olivia: Done, updated PR. Will roll in 15min.
SRE-bot: If auto-rollback triggers, oncall: @kevin will be paged. live: https://monitoring.redwood.ai/dashboards/cny-20260317-01
Olivia: Thanks all — will report back at end of window with metrics + winners/losers. :rocket:
